**📅 August 24, 2026**
**📊 Market Sentiment:** Bearish
**🎯 Confidence:** High

**🧠 Key Themes**
• US-Canada trade war erupts as talks collapse and retaliatory tariffs hit
• Treasury bond-market intervention fails to stem rising yields amid $40T debt anxiety
• Nvidia earnings and Jackson Hole stack event risk in a fragile tape
• Consumer weakness surfaces with Walmart’s slowest sales growth in years

**⚠️ Notable Risks**
• Bond-market confidence cracking as "Bessent Put" fizzles and fiscal dominance grows
• Iran sanctions and Red Sea tensions threatening energy supply chains
• AI sector repricing risk if Nvidia guidance misses elevated capex expectations

**📈 Volatility Outlook:** Rising

**🧾 One-Line Take**
Trade-war escalation, a revolting bond market, and a crowded catalyst calendar are driving a volatility expansion that makes short-gamma exposure dangerous ahead of Nvidia and Jackson Hole.
